title: knowledge: three false-positive guards from BCApps PR 10277, 10278 and 10346
summary: Quality rules were refined to eliminate false positives about missing cleanups in insert-only transfers, mandatory affixes in non-AppSource apps, and permission context lowering in tests. Three knowledge articles were added or updated with better preconditions to keep genuine defects reportable.
key_points: New article clarifies that insert-only transfers are safe when the caller's OnValidate trigger cleans up the target range first
AppSource affix requirement now correctly scoped to apps with AppSourceCop enabled and configured with mandatory affix
Permission test guidance refined to recognize effective permission context through role composition, not just direct permission set assignment
All three false positives were verified against actual BCApps code before writing the rules
Genuine defects remain reportable: missing cleanup with different filters or reachable paths without cleanup
quote: Three false-positive guards adjudicated from self-improvement runs on BCApps PR 10277, 10278 and 10346.
